title: Tiny Crosshair
description: This Project Makes the default Minecraft crosshair smaller and cleaner for better visibility and precision. Perfect for PvP and minimal UI setups.
body:
This is my first resource pack! I’m new to making packs, so I hope you enjoy it.  

This pack replaces the default Minecraft crosshair with a smaller, cleaner version.  

Tip: My GUI scale is set to 2 (second smallest in vanilla Minecraft), so the crosshair looks best at smaller GUI settings.  

Note: I did not change the attack indicator background or progress bars, so they might look slightly different with this pack.

---

**Installation:**
1. Locate your `.minecraft` folder (inside `%appdata%`).  
2. Open the `resourcepacks` folder.  
3. Download this pack and place it inside the folder.  
4. Open Minecraft and activate it from the Resource Packs menu.  
5. Enjoy!  

---

This pack is simple, lightweight, and works with vanilla Minecraft. Have fun customizing your crosshair!                
I may make more crosshair types in the future.
